parameters.name: redirectTo
parameters.description: Absolute URL to redirect back to after successful Google OAuth. Must match allowed web origin.

parameters.name: redirectTo
parameters.description: Absolute URL to redirect back after successful OLX OAuth. Must match allowed web origin.

parameters.name: channelAccountId
parameters.description: Optional existing OLX channel account id to re-link OAuth credentials into.

parameters.name: showOlder
parameters.description: If true, searches full history (otherwise defaults to recent window)

200.description: Outbox status counters and backlog summary.
Latest outbox events for current workspace.

info.title: Omnichat API
info.description: Classic NestJS REST API. Source of truth: OpenAPI (/docs).

details.description: Optional machine-readable details. Present for validation errors.

code.description: One-time OAuth exchange code returned to the web app by the /callback redirect.

contextStatusId.description: Channel-side order/listing status id (e.g. Rozetka order_status id)

contextStatusName.description: Human-readable label for contextStatusId, resolved via /order-statuses/search with a built-in 1–50 fallback

confirmUnpin.description: Required when archiving a pinned conversation. Equivalent to "Unpin & Archive".

until.description: ISO datetime until which PUSH notifications are suppressed

statusId.description: Set to null to clear status

previewUrl.description: Presigned download URL valid for ~7 days. Populated for IMAGE / VIDEO kinds so the inbox can render media inline without an extra round-trip; null for DOCUMENT (operator clicks 'Відкрити' to mint a short-link).

metadata.description: Structured payload for synthesized event messages (e.g. Rozetka order events). Schema is discriminated by metadata.kind on the consumer side. May be null for ordinary chat messages.

alias.description: Display alias for the linked Prom account. Defaults to a generated PROM alias.

channelAccountId.description: Optional existing PROM channel account id to re-link with a new API token.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional explicit Prom API base URL. Defaults to https://my.prom.ua/api/v1.

apiToken.description: Prom company API token from the merchant cabinet.

alias.description: Display alias for this channel account
Display alias for the linked Rozetka account. Defaults to a generated ROZETKA alias.

channelAccountId.description: Optional existing ROZETKA channel account id to re-link with a new API token.

apiBaseUrl.description: Optional explicit Rozetka API base URL. Defaults to https://api-seller.rozetka.com.ua.

apiToken.description: Rozetka seller API token bound to a role with correspondence access.

token.description: Push token (Expo token for mobile; opaque string for web)
Opaque push token (for debugging; client already knows this value).

url.description: Relative URL to the short-link landing endpoint.

hourlyActivity.description: Message counts grouped by hour-of-day (0..23) for last 24h.

failureRatePct.description: Failure percent in the observed interval (0-100).

statuses.description: Statuses to include for requeue; PROCESSING is included only when stale by maxAgeSec.
